subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar conectores indicadores de adição, condição, oposição, contraste, conclusão e síntese como auxiliares na construção da argumentação e intencionalidade discursiva.

components.description_pt: Selecionar conectores que indicam adição, condição ou oposição para construir argumentação
components.description_en: Select connectors that indicate addition, condition, or opposition to build argumentation
components.cc_component_description: Identify signal words in a text that indicate comparison, cause/effect, or sequence relationships

components.description_pt: Usar conectores de contraste, conclusão e síntese para organizar intencionalidade discursiva
components.description_en: Use connectors of contrast, conclusion, and synthesis to organize discursive intentionality
components.cc_component_description: Organize ideas using strategies such as definition, classification, comparison/contrast, or cause/effect

components.description_pt: Selecionar palavras-sinal precisas para expressar relações lógicas entre ideias
components.description_en: Select precise signal words to convey logical relationships between ideas
components.cc_component_description: Select precise signal words to convey logical relationships between ideas

cc_matches.description: Acquire and use accurately grade-appropriate general academic and domain-specific words and phrases, including those that signal contrast, addition, and other logical relationships (e.g., however, although, nevertheless, similarly, moreover, in addition).
Describe the logical connection between particular sentences and paragraphs in a text (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, first/second/third in a sequence).

Introduce a topic; organize ideas, concepts, and information, using strategies such as definition, classification, comparison/contrast, and cause/effect; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
